detail.longDescription: Originally released July 28, 2026. A new customer just placed their first order, 12 products due out Friday. Your warehouse packs from a table with one row per product, and nothing ships until every row has a check mark. If your Zap drops that order into a single record, the packer gets a paragraph instead of a checklist. Somewhere around product nine, a line gets skipped. Your new customer's first box arrives one product short. Twelve products should mean twelve rows, and now your Zap can write
